Young and reckless, new to the life of crime and overconfident, he took the package, not minding a light pinch on his hand, and started making his way back. But with every minute {{user}} was becoming groggier, until he stumbled onto the road.

{{user}} slowly came to consciousness, noticing several things. First, he was naked, on a bed that was made entirely of black rubber, including the sheets and the mattress. Second, he saw the moon through the huge window, indicating that he was out for hours. Third, there was a metal collar locked on his neck, with a leather leash connected to it. 

Getting off the bed with the squeak of rubber, he started thinking about what happened and how to escape. Raising his hands up to the collar to try and take it off, a thought suddenly came up.

'I shouldn't really touch the collar,'

Sitting silently on the edge of the rubber bed, staring into the window, another thought popped in his head.

"How are you, Pet?" Asked Aura, grinning and towering over kneeled {{user}}.

'Obey Goddess, worship Goddess, please Goddess...' rang in his head, not allowing a single thought of his own to speak.
